name: ackwatch
description: A local-first attention monitor for Matrix

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node tools/build-instructions.mjs dist && node tools/assert-production-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:catalog: tsc -b && vite build --mode catalog --outDir dist-catalog && node tools/build-instructions.mjs dist-catalog
scripts.test:visual: npm run build:catalog && env -u FORCE_COLOR PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.cache/ms-playwright playwright test --config=playwright.visual.config.ts --project=visual && node tools/generate-gallery.mjs
scripts.test:scale: npm run build:benchmark && env -u FORCE_COLOR PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.cache/ms-playwright playwright test --config=playwright.scale.config.ts --project=scale
scripts.test:matrix:local: npm run build && env -u FORCE_COLOR PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.cache/ms-playwright node tests/matrix/local-controller.mjs
scripts.test:soak: npm run build && env -u FORCE_COLOR PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.cache/ms-playwright node tests/soak/soak-controller.mjs
scripts.setup:browsers: env -u FORCE_COLOR PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.cache/ms-playwright playwright install chromium firefox
scripts.check:fast: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:gate1: node tools/record-step.mjs --reset && npm run check:fast && node tools/record-step.mjs fastChecks && npm run build && node tools/record-step.mjs productionBuild && npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual && npm run audit:secrets && node tools/record-step.mjs secretScan && npm run audit:tracked && node tools/record-step.mjs trackedFileAudit && npm run audit:dependencies && node tools/record-step.mjs dependencyAudit && npm run report:licenses && npm run report:gate1
scripts.check:gate2: node tools/record-step.mjs --reset && npm run check:fast && node tools/record-step.mjs fastChecks && npm run build && node tools/record-step.mjs productionBuild && npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual && npm run test:matrix:local && npm run test:matrix:remote && npm run audit:secrets && node tools/record-step.mjs secretScan && npm run audit:tracked && node tools/record-step.mjs trackedFileAudit && npm run audit:dependencies && node tools/record-step.mjs dependencyAudit && npm run report:licenses && npm run report:gate2
scripts.check:gate3: node tools/record-step.mjs --reset && npm run check:fast && node tools/record-step.mjs fastChecks && npm run build && node tools/record-step.mjs productionBuild && npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual && npm run test:matrix:local && npm run test:matrix:remote && npm run audit:secrets && node tools/record-step.mjs secretScan && npm run audit:tracked && node tools/record-step.mjs trackedFileAudit && npm run audit:dependencies && node tools/record-step.mjs dependencyAudit && npm run report:licenses && npm run report:gate3
scripts.check:gate4: node tools/record-step.mjs --reset && npm run check:fast && node tools/record-step.mjs fastChecks && npm run build && node tools/record-step.mjs productionBuild && npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual && npm run test:matrix:local && npm run test:matrix:remote && npm run test:webhook:local && npm run audit:secrets && node tools/record-step.mjs secretScan && npm run audit:tracked && node tools/record-step.mjs trackedFileAudit && npm run audit:dependencies && node tools/record-step.mjs dependencyAudit && npm run report:licenses && npm run report:gate4
scripts.check:gate5: node tools/record-step.mjs --reset && npm run check:fast && node tools/record-step.mjs fastChecks && npm run build && node tools/record-step.mjs productionBuild && npm run test:browser && npm run test:visual && npm run test:scale && npm run test:matrix:local && npm run test:matrix:remote && npm run test:webhook:local && npm run audit:secrets && node tools/record-step.mjs secretScan && npm run audit:tracked && node tools/record-step.mjs trackedFileAudit && npm run audit:dependencies && node tools/record-step.mjs dependencyAudit && npm run report:licenses && npm run report:gate5
